scope: Local surface SourceT1w path, provenance and merge-integration contracts; geometry, registration and projection computation are mocked. This is not an accuracy or performance benchmark.
source_state: Working-tree SourceT1w selection fix based on the recorded revision; exact tested files are identified by SHA-256 below.
new_contracts: An external-storage T1 file symlink retains its BIDS name and Sources in preproc and clean modes.
Either exact logical BIDS T1 path can be selected when two candidates link to one physical file.
Absolute SourceT1w values and any parent path component are rejected.
A T1 belonging to another subject is rejected.
A non-exact alias cannot choose between multiple candidates with one physical target.

additional_orchestration_control.scope: Read-only control using the same public contract fixture; no real MSM invocation.

privacy: Contains only relative source paths, hashes, aggregate test results and test descriptions; no real participant data, credentials or private absolute paths.
